questions.stem: A 5-year-old boy went to the temple in a village with his grandmother. He was crying inconsolably on the way back. He was taken to the emergency department within 3 hours. He had altered sensorium, cold clammy extremities, increased salivation, and excessive sweating. On examination, he was pale and had priapism with the following vitals - BP - 140/78 mmHg, HR - 152/min, RR - 36/min SPO2 of 96%. Which of the following would you use in his management?
questions.solutionHtml:
Prazosin
  • The clinical scenario is regarding scorpion bite, for which prazosin can be used in the management. It is a physiological antidote against the adrenergic surge.


K.D TRIPATHI -ESSENTIALS OF MEDICAL PHARMACOLOGY 8TH EDITION PAGE NO. 137-138

questions.stem: An anti-diabetic drug causes a decrease in HbA1C by causing an increase in GIP and GLP-1 levels and a decrease in glucagon levels. It is an oral drug causing a reduction in both pre and post-prandial glucose. The drug is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Alogliptin
  • Alogliptin is a DPP4 inhibitor used as an oral hypoglycemic drug.

questions.solutionHtml:
MDR1

questions.stem: A patient was started on a drug for mood disorder and he developed priapism. The causative drug is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Trazodone
  • Commonly reported side effects of trazodone include: blurred vision, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, nausea, vomiting, and xerostomia.
  • Other side effects include: syncope, edema, ataxia, confusion, diarrhea, hypotension, insomnia, sedated state, and tachycardia.


Essentials of medical pharmacology,8th edition, page no-490

questions.stem: Which is a rare but very severe side effect of clozapine that requires regular monitoring?
questions.solutionHtml:
Agranulocytosis

  • Agranulocytosis is a rare but very severe side effect of clozapine that requires regular monitoring. Clozapine is known to cause a rare but serious side effect called “agranulocytosis”.

questions.stem: True about therapeutic index of a drug is?

options.label: A
options.text: Denotes safety and efficacy in population

options.label: B
options.text: Denotes safety and efficacy in individual

options.label: C
options.text: Ratio of medial lethal dose in 50% of population to median effective dose in 50% of population

options.label: D
options.text: Ratio of median lethal dose in 50% population to median effective dose in 50%of population.

questions.answerText: Denotes safety and efficacy in individual
questions.solutionHtml:
Denotes safety and efficacy in individual
  • The therapeutic  index of a drug denotes the safety and efficacy of the drug in the population

questions.stem: Osimertinib is used in NSCLC with mutation due to which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
T 790M mutation
  • Osimertinib, sold under the brand name Tagrisso, is a medication used to treat non-small-cell lung carcinomas with specific mutations T790M. It is a third-generation epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

options.label: D

questions.answerText: Inhibition of IL2, IL4 and IL5

questions.stem: A patient underwent a hysterectomy and was given morphine in the post- operative period and in the ward for pain. She now presents with respiratory depression and pinpoint pupils. What is the drug used to treat this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Naloxone
  • Naloxone is an opioid receptor antagonist used to rapidly reverse an opioid overdose.


Goodman and gillman’s the pharmacological basis of therapeutics,13th edition page no-359

questions.stem: Which of the following is a new drug approved by the FDA approved by the FDA for the treatment of Rett syndrome?
questions.solutionHtml:
Trofinetide
  • Monoclonal antibody approved for Rett syndrome is Trofinetide.
  • Trofinetide is a synthetic peptide that acts as a neurotrophic factor and is being developed as a potential treatment for Rett syndrome.
  • It works by targeting the underlying mechanisms associated with Rett syndrome, such as modulating synaptic connections and reducing neuroinflammation.
